title: Trump creates Super Intelligence Force to oversee AI
seoTitle: Trump creates Super Intelligence Force to oversee AI
subtitle: President appoints national intelligence chief to lead the task force amid growing concerns about the technology.
excerpt: The president announced the creation of a task force focused on AI policy, appointing the national intelligence chief as its leader.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The president announced the creation of the so‑called Super Intelligence Force, a task force aimed at overseeing artificial‑intelligence policy. The move comes at a time when concerns over the development and advancement of AI continue to rise.

To lead the new group, the president appointed the national intelligence chief. The designation places the task force’s leadership under the country’s intelligence apparatus, reflecting the heightened focus on the issue today.

The initiative directly addresses the management of guidelines and rules related to the technology. With the growing debate around artificial intelligence, the task force will now concentrate official oversight of the matter, integrating it into the governmental structure responsible for the topic.

With information from BBC News.
